obituaries.full_text:
HARMON: In Rehoboth Delaware on May 15, 
1967
, Clinton L. father of Thomas and Walter Harmon of Rehoboth, Russell of Philadelphia and Mrs. Mildred Meadows of Philadelphia, Pa. Aged 80 years. Relatives and friends are invited to attend funeral services at the Mt. Pleasant Methodist Church, Rehoboth Del. on Saturday afternoon, May 20 at 3 o'clock. Interment at People's Memorial Park, Rehoboth. Friends may call at the church on Friday evening from 7 to 9 o'clock. Arrangements by the Stevenson Funeral Home, Dover, Delaware.

E. Lincoln Harmon  
November 18, 
1867
